decisions.reason: This mitred door lever handle family is very close to the firm's established architectural hardware knowledge base and its continued website presence suggests the firm can learn from market feedback and refine it rather than withdraw it.

The multifunctional door lever handle builds directly on the firm's core door-hardware capabilities, and its own page in 2024 indicates enough strategic relevance and absorptive capacity to support continued commercialization.

As a standard door lever handle family within the firm's main competence area, it fits existing engineering, certification and manufacturing know-how, so management would likely retain it unless sales were clearly weak.
This door and window handle collection is strongly aligned with the firm's core product families and its repeated dedicated promotion plus design awards make withdrawal within a year very unlikely.
